voice.speaker: comms
voice.text: The Halcyon Drift went dark eleven years ago. Its navigation core still holds where it had been. Cut in at the aft airlock, pull the core from the archive, and carry it back out before the hull lets go.
voice.voiceDesign: A middle-aged ship communications officer, gender-neutral, with a flat, tired, measured voice reading a mission transmission over a long-range radio link: unhurried, clear, no warmth, slight static.

voice.speaker: comms
voice.text: The berth deck is where the Drift's crew went to sleep and never woke. The manifest drive in the berth control room says who they were and what they carried. Cut in at the west airlock, work the lanes between the berth blocks, and bring the drive out before the Molt close the galleries.
voice.voiceDesign: A middle-aged ship communications officer, gender-neutral, with a flat, tired, measured voice reading a mission transmission over a long-range radio link: unhurried, clear, no warmth, slight static.

voice.speaker: comms
voice.text: The reactor deck is the last of the Drift still warm, and the Molt nest closest to it. The reactor's black box holds the final hours of the ship. Cut in at the forward airlock, run the spine through two sealed bulkheads, and get the box out before the swarm wakes in force.
voice.voiceDesign: A middle-aged ship communications officer, gender-neutral, with a flat, tired, measured voice reading a mission transmission over a long-range radio link: unhurried, clear, no warmth, slight static.
